title: Unit Event — Competitive Fire! — Episode5 Fuse

meta.Event Outline: When Vivid BAD SQUAD go for a meal with Ken, Taiga and the twins before their return to Japan, an unexpected reunion sparks a newfound fire in An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: People definitely know who they are.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: “Do your best to keep up with us, you guys!”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Whew! They're really going all out right from the start!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: They're controlling their breathing a lot like how Taiga and Ken did during their performance yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That sensation of being hit with a huge blast of sound.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's not a perfect imitation, but it's really close. They're able to do that after just seeing it once?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Their natural talent helps, but... Their power of absorption is incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: “I'm glad that you enjoyed yourself, but you improvised way too much... I wasn't sure if we could hold things together until the end.”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
“Haha. Sorry!
But I knew you'd keep up, Ceddy.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That was an excellent singing performance.
I have many questions and comments for you...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Thanks. We can talk about all of that later.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
We don't want to eat into your stage time!
So, have fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's natural for them to react this way.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (If we're going to perform in RUSH BEATS, then we need to be able to turn this place upside down!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Otherwise, we'll never be able to stand on top of the world!)

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: “I thought this when we heard Kohane sing, but... All of them are so direct and powerful, huh?”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “Yeah. Their English pronunciation still needs some work for sure...”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “But they remind me of RADder from way back when.”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Nice work, you guys!
That was a great performance!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah, you also got a nice reaction from the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we can still do better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Agreed. We need to figure out how to get the audience's attention right from the start.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it's still hard for us to really channel in our feelings when we sing in English. Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was obvious they're popular from that street performance, but... This is something else.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Any music lover worth their salt around here knows these two.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: As far as the favorites for winning RUSH BEATS this year goes...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: I can say without a doubt that illys would get the most votes from the people in this city.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
This atmosphere feels way different from yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As if a fuse has been lit...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A fuse? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “They just kicked into such a high gear...!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A lit fuse to make an explosion, huh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (They've grabbed hold of my heart and are making it beat like crazy...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You hear them once and can never forget.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
That's coming through very clearly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: From their singing, I can sense anger and a significant amount of frustration...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
At first, I thought it was the song...
But that's not the only reason.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: But we don't want anything to do with you now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't know what happened between them.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But this song's...kinda hard to listen to.)
